post.description:
A file up to 20 MiB: image, PDF, DOCX, XLSX, CSV, text, HTML or audio. The type is read
from the bytes. The file stays unsent until a message carries it.

delete.description: Only a file that no message carries yet.

get.description:
The bytes, shown in place when a browser can show them safely (HTML never is), with
byte ranges so that audio can be played and sought on every browser. A range is cut by the
database; a refused range reads nothing.

post.description:
Answers a block. A secret input goes straight into the Vault (`transient`, 10 minutes);
only the fact of the answer is stored. A second answer to the same block is `409`.

get.description:
text/event-stream: status | block | block_update | error | done; resume by Last-Event-ID.

Only the owner of the job may listen. The stream replays the buffered events after
`Last-Event-ID`, then follows the job until it ends; `: keepalive` every 15 seconds.

204.description: The job has ended and nothing is newer than Last-Event-ID
